default.notes: Not on the visa-exemption or visa-on-arrival list — apply to the Immigration Division of Tonga before travelling, allowing several weeks; airlines will not board you without the visa.

groups.notes: Visa exemption — up to 90 days within any 180-day period, granted on arrival with no application or fee.

A visitor's visa is issued free of charge on arrival for 31 days, on presentation of a passport valid 6 months beyond departure, an onward ticket and proof of funds. It can be extended month by month up to a total stay of about six months.

TO.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Tongan citizens.

AE.notes: Emirati passport holders are visa-exempt for up to 60 days under a bilateral exemption agreement.

CN.notes: Chinese passport holders are visa-exempt for up to 30 days; the arrangement has been narrowed in the past, so confirm with Tonga Immigration before booking.
